task.description:
BACKEND-DEV Step 3 — implement the docs-only fix for ISS-0085 / GOV-01 by applying the design at src/design/uat-scenario-schema-v1.1-apply.md to the consumer docs.

This is a docs-only change. NO Zig code, NO SQL migrations. Touch ONLY:
- docs/agents/UAT_RUNNER.md
- docs/agents/PRODUCT_OWNER.md
- docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR.md (add new §8e Platform-Workflow UAT Gate per design)
- docs/agents/workflows/WF-05_uat_run.md
- docs/agents/workflows/WF-06_scenario_authoring.md
- CLAUDE.md (optional one-line addendum pointer)

DO NOT touch:
- docs/agents/BO-SWIFTROUTE.md
- docs/agents/BO-VORTEX.md
- docs/agents/BO-MERIDIAN.md
- src/ (Zig source)
- migrations/ (SQL)

For each of the 13 edits in the design (1.1-1.5, 2.1-2.3, 3.1, 4.1-4.3, 5.1-5.2, 6.1), apply the before->after text replacement at the documented anchor location.

After applying all edits:
1. Run: python tools/lint_handoffs.py (must exit 0)
2. Run: python tools/lint_design_artefact.py src/design/uat-scenario-schema-v1.1-apply.md (still must exit 0 — design unchanged, but verify no breakage)
3. Verify by grep: docs/agents/UAT_RUNNER.md, docs/agents/PRODUCT_OWNER.md, docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR.md, docs/agents/workflows/WF-05_uat_run.md, docs/agents/workflows/WF-06_scenario_authoring.md each now mention platform_workflow or company_id: platform or via: system (depending on what the design prescribes).
4. git add -A && git commit -m "docs(WF03-GH300): apply UAT scenario schema v1.1 addendum to agent docs (ISS-0085 / GOV-01)"
5. git push origin feature/WF03-GH300-20260810

Return PASS once all 5 edits have been applied, lint passes, and the commit is on the remote branch.
acceptance_criteria: All 13 edits in src/design/uat-scenario-schema-v1.1-apply.md have been applied to the consumer docs
docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR.md has new §8e Platform-Workflow UAT Gate referencing tools/wfctl.py uat-ready
docs/agents/workflows/WF-06_scenario_authoring.md allows REQ-ANALYST as author for platform scenarios
Three BO-* docs are NOT touched
